name: Che Guevara
role: Argentine-Cuban revolutionary and Cuban minister of industries (1961–1965)
summary: Guevara advocated socialist revolution, public ownership and central planning, combined with moral incentives and the formation of a new socialist consciousness. He supported guerrilla struggle, anti-colonial liberation and international economic arrangements favouring dependent countries.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: He sought to overcome commodity relations and the necessity of selling oneself through labour.

abolish-wage-labour.rationale: He held that a person reaches a full human condition only when no longer compelled to produce by the physical necessity of selling oneself as a commodity.

accelerate-technology.rationale: He urged scientific and technical education to accelerate socialist economic development.

alienated-labor.rationale: He described overcoming work as compelled commodity sale as part of full human liberation.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: He said arms must be supplied free to peoples fighting their common imperialist enemy.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: He said insurrection itself can create revolutionary conditions, given essential mass support.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: He said Cuba supports and applauds peoples such as those of Angola and South Vietnam who, having exhausted peaceful solutions, take up arms against colonial and imperialist rule.

arms-reduction.rationale: He supported general and complete disarmament and destruction of thermonuclear devices.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: He treated imperialism as a worldwide system whose domination generates wars and liberation struggles.

central-planning.rationale: He explicitly called centralised planning the defining feature of socialist society.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: He preferred collective public health and solidarity to isolated individual charity.

class-collaboration.rationale: He said the national bourgeoisie could not lead liberation because it feared social revolution.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: He rejected material reward and commodity values as the organising principles of socialist life.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: He called for international action against racial oppression and supported liberation movements.

death-penalty.rationale: He said the war criminals of the old army were shot before a firing squad openly and with a clear conscience, and that the people of Cuba shot their murderers.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: He rejected equating bourgeois legal elections and liberties with emancipation from class dictatorship.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: He endorsed proletarian dictatorship as necessary to abolish classes and build socialist unity.

direct-action.rationale: He advocated guerrilla struggle for power rather than limiting revolutionaries to bourgeois legality.

dominated-front.rationale: He demanded an alliance of socialist states and underdeveloped peoples against imperialism.

duties-before-rights.rationale: He subordinated individual professional advancement to duties of solidarity and collective well-being.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: He opposed foreign monopolies’ control over dependent economies and defended economic sovereignty.

free-trade.rationale: He rejected claims that exchange at prevailing world-market prices was mutually beneficial for poor countries.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: He said political independence was incomplete without ending imperialist economic domination.

independent-unions.rationale: He called on Latin American governments to guarantee the freedoms that allow the working-class movement to organise independent trade unions and denounced the subordination of the trade union movement.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: He analysed commodity value through socially necessary labour while restricting its role in socialist allocation.

land-redistribution.rationale: He praised distributing absentee landlords’ land to those who worked it.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: He opposed using the law of value as the directing mechanism of socialist production.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: He contrasted planning with the law of value and denied market allocation between state enterprises.

moral-incentives.rationale: He prioritised moral incentives and voluntary work while allowing limited material incentives.

municipal-property.rationale: He preferred coordinated national state ownership to separately owned local productive enterprises.

nation-first.rationale: He urged revolutionaries to sacrifice across national borders in a common struggle against imperialism.

national-resource-control.rationale: He demanded liberation from foreign control of resources and economic decisions.

national-self-determination.rationale: He defended colonised peoples’ full sovereignty and their struggle for independence.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: He demanded an end to foreign military bases imposed against host peoples’ sovereignty.

one-party-rule.rationale: He promoted a single United Party of the Socialist Revolution directing the revolutionary state.

opposition-only-legal-channels.rationale: He called it an unpardonable error to look only to elections and not to other forms of struggle, including armed struggle, to achieve power.

parliamentary-road-socialism.rationale: He did not exclude change beginning through elections but called it very remote, arguing that the army would side with the reactionary classes and overthrow an elected government.

participatory-democracy.rationale: He called for fuller individual participation in management and production, while acknowledging institutional shortcomings.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: He required creative initiative within disciplined acceptance of central revolutionary directives.

positive-liberty.rationale: He linked human freedom to overcoming alienation and gaining conscious control of production.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: He advocated low administered prices for goods fundamental to life, regardless of their market values.

priority-to-poor.rationale: He urged medical professionals and revolutionary institutions to prioritise deprived rural people.

production-for-use.rationale: His budgetary system directed output and prices toward social priorities rather than each enterprise’s profit.

property-fundamental.rationale: He explicitly placed human life and feeding peasants above rich owners’ sacrosanct property claims.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: His instructions to urban cadres list sabotage of centres of economic activity among the armed actions to be carried out.

public-ownership.rationale: He treated state industrial establishments as parts of one large publicly owned enterprise.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: He condemned South African apartheid and officially enforced racial superiority.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: He called for international trade and development arrangements that overcome dependent countries’ exploitation.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: He demanded socialist states materially assist poorer countries without reproducing unequal exchange.

rule-by-example.rationale: He insisted cadres earn workers’ respect through personal example and sacrifice.

self-interest-moral.rationale: He opposed capitalist individual material interest as the basis for forming socialist consciousness.

shared-human-nature.rationale: He advocated creating a new socialist human being through social transformation and education.

state-class-instrument.rationale: He described the bourgeois state as the coercive expression of irreconcilable class antagonisms.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: He defended poorer countries’ development needs while condemning rich-country barriers to their exports.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: He required simultaneous transformation of consciousness and technology, rather than treating technology alone as liberation.

territorial-expansion.rationale: He demanded respect for existing state borders and abstention from aggression.

total-state.rationale: He assigned state and party education a comprehensive role in forming socialist consciousness.

universal-healthcare.rationale: He assigned the Health Ministry responsibility for extending public and preventive services to the greatest possible number.

vanguard-party.rationale: He called for a party of exemplary workers whose leadership raises mass socialist consciousness.

workers-nation.rationale: His final message urged international revolutionary solidarity across Asia, Africa and Latin America.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: He condemned world-market prices and unequal exchange for exploiting underdeveloped countries.

notes: The 1967 message is used for his final international strategy. Public-health and land policies are supported by his own statements, not merely Cuban party affiliation. No position is attributed from later Cuban family, sexuality, religious or environmental policies; the historical record examined does not resolve those statements. Later pass under rules 7: every source tagged as his words. All 1959-1967 texts in the local Marxists archive were searched by theme (labour and unions, women, religion, race, sabotage and legal channels, elections, bureaucracy, democracy, debt, nuclear arms and disarmament, art, cooperatives, division of labour, international law, free services); statements still null had nothing that settles them (for instance debt: he proposed suspending payments, not cancelling; art: he rejected dogmatic socialist realism without proposing censorship). The 1964 UN General Assembly text on marxists.org contains no passage on executions, so his position on the death penalty rests on his 1960 and 1961 speeches. His record in Cuban offices is not sourced beyond his own words (see notFound).
